scenario: Compile-time enforcement per LFAC.4.5 — `emit X logical` requires X's schema lifecycle to be `logical` (covered by LFAC.1.2.5 + LLOG.11.1); `t.dwell` on `ttl`-schema bindings is a compile error. The dwell-on-ttl direction is blocked: v1 compiler has no special `dwell` recognition; `t.dwell` on a TTL schema rejects via the generic no-such-slot path, not the LFAC.4.5-specific dwell-on-ttl diagnostic. Pin uses the covered emit/lifecycle direction.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Bar scope ttl 1_h:
    a: Int

rule r:
    Trig
->
    emit Bar logical a: 1
